display.purpose: Local Anton 400, condensed headings inspired by the supplied Alethe reference; synthetic weights disabled.

body.purpose: Local Space Grotesk variable, 17-18px; Geist Mono variable for navigation, terminals and metadata.

motion.name: logo
motion.purpose: ASCII Matrix autoplay; continuous requestAnimationFrame loop at a 30fps draw cap; no reduced-motion or viewport pause; no pause control. Browser background throttling still applies. Logo is about 15% smaller and dynamically centered by projected silhouette bounds.

motion.name: ribbon
motion.purpose: Brutalist Anton 32-58px in two identical looping groups; one static wrapping group under reduced motion.

motion.name: cursor
motion.purpose: Green ring/white point; 36px on links, compact 28px green arrow with white outline on projects. Subtle 220-300ms crossfades, reversible transitions and persistent fading Explorar label. No cutout, fold, rotation or shadow.

motion.name: halftone-background
motion.purpose: Canvas dots react to mouse movement and clicks; finite settling loop; static on touch and direct tracking under reduced motion.

motion.name: projects-button
motion.purpose: Lime fill from arrow; arrow rotates and cycles on hover; keyboard focus also reveals fill.

narrative.northStar: Alethe-inspired condensed typography and a terminal-framed ASCII identity, with an interactive halftone background.
narrative.overview: See DESIGN.md and styles.css for the implemented contract. Editorial studio inherits the default dark/off-white/acid-green root palette by latest explicit user request; keep the layout and no technical chips.
